title: Thailand watchdog plans legal action against Meta's Facebook for failing to protect against scammers

title: Morning Bid: Summer clouds
summary: June 4 (Reuters) - What matters in U. and global markets today , Editor-at-Large, Finance and Markets The S&P; 500 failed to clock its 10th straight daily gain on Wednesday and there are some clouds gathering in markets.
summary_zh: 6 月 4 日（路透社）- 当今美国和全球市场最重要的是什么，标准普尔金融与市场特约编辑；周三，500 指数未能连续第十个交易日上涨，市场上阴云密布。

title: Former School of Rock CEO's guide to overcoming midlife burnout
title_zh: 摇滚学院前首席执行官克服中年倦怠的指南
summary: Former School of Rock CEO Matt Ross details his journey scaling creative education franchises like School of Rock, overcoming intense personal and professional hardships, and the life lessons on mental health and purpose detailed in his book, Grow or Fold.
summary_zh: School of Rock 前首席执行官马特·罗斯 (Matt Ross) 详细介绍了他扩展 School of Rock 等创意教育特许经营权的历程、克服个人和职业上的巨大困难，以及在他的书《成长或折叠》中详细介绍的有关心理健康和目标的人生教训。

title: Amazon unveils new AI warehouse robot in $12 billion Europe push
title_zh: 亚马逊斥资120亿美元在欧洲推出新型人工智能仓库机器人
summary: Amazon on Thursday unveiled an upgraded AI-powered mobile robot for its warehouses that can ‌respond to conversational prompts, as part of a €10 billion ($11.6 billion) investment ‌in its European fulfilment network.
summary_zh: 亚马逊周四为其仓库推出了一款升级版的人工智能移动机器人，该机器人可以响应对话提示，这是其欧洲配送网络 100 亿欧元（116 亿美元）投资的一部分。

title: TSMC boss bets big on AI growth, says he'd 'like' to hike chip prices
title_zh: 台积电老板对人工智能增长押下重注，称他“希望”提高芯片价格
summary: STORY: The world's largest contract chipmaker TSMC says it's confident in its growth over the next few years...thanks to robust demand for computing power and advanced semiconductors as it rides a relentless AI boom.The Taiwanese firm's CEO spoke at its annual shareholders mee...
summary_zh: 故事：全球最大的代工芯片制造商台积电表示，对其未来几年的增长充满信心……这要归功于人工智能的蓬勃发展，对计算能力和先进半导体的强劲需求。这家台湾公司的首席执行官在年度股东大会上发表讲话……

title: Why a broader market could mean trouble for growth stocks
title_zh: 为什么更广泛的市场可能会给成长型股票带来麻烦
summary: Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton sits down with Stifel Vice President, Portfolio Strategy Thomas Carroll to discuss the risk of market broadening on growth.
